readerOnlyObservations.details: Initial rg/sed looked for native-scalar-harness at the wrong parent, a nonexistent tests/builtins/interface-audit path, and unmatched zsh wildcard component/header/embedding paths. Correct existing foundations harness, capability-policy and frozen componentize-source embedding paths were then read. No source writes or owner action resulted.
